component.text: Assign a patient with the Clipboard. Use the Thermometer, Stethoscope, Otoscope, Reflex Hammer and Pulse Oximeter.
Print a Medical Report only after collecting useful findings. Reports are bound to the exact infection and improve vaccine research.
Temperature, lung sounds, oxygen saturation, perfusion, reflexes and tissue findings each expose a different part of the disease. A single normal reading does not prove that the patient is healthy.
